title: Classification of environmental conditions, Part 2: Environmental conditions appearing in nature, Section 7: Fauna and flora
clause_1_scope: this Indian Standard deals with classification of environmental parameters and their severities.
clause_3_terminology: Part 2: Environmental conditions appearing in nature

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
